questions.stance: No. Stdlib-only adapters remain until an ADR accepts the dependency.

questions.area: Agent catalog / AI Agent development durability
questions.question: Should final production persistence use assignment operation journals, separate catalog journals, or a DynamoDB single-table projection?
questions.stance: AI Agent client development state now uses a durable DynamoDB snapshot item plus bounded recent client stream replay events. Full production projection, agent catalog durability, and rotation/revocation topology remain future slices.
questions.next_command: gh issue create --repo teamswyg/riido-control-plane --title "Q-CP-002 production persistence projection" --body "Produce production persistence projection manifest for agent catalog durability and rotation topology."

questions.question: Which IdP/JWKS claim mapping becomes the production authorizer contract?
questions.stance: Use issuer-routed dual authentication: Riido Auth exact issuer/resource/profile tokens require local ES256/JWKS verification, introspection and the consumer domain PDP, while foreign issuers continue through the existing legacy authorizer.
questions.resolution: The accepted mapping is iss=https://auth.riido.io, aud=https://ai-api.riido.io, authorization_profile=riido-control-plane.production.v1, typ=at+jwt, alg=ES256, canonical non-wildcard scopes and exact introspection claim equivalence. A token claiming the Riido Auth issuer cannot fall back after any failure; a foreign or missing issuer may be evaluated only by the independently authenticating legacy authorizer. Token validation never supplies tenant authorization, and the domain authorizer must return the same subject and requested workspace. Production activation remains a separate infra evidence gate.

questions.question: Should stdout EMF remain the only public metrics publisher, or should Prometheus/OpenTelemetry become a contract?
questions.stance: Stdout EMF is the only public publisher. Dashboards and exporters stay infra-owned.
questions.next_command: gh issue create --repo teamswyg/riido-control-plane --title "Q-CP-004 observability exporter policy" --body "Produce observability exporter policy manifest for EMF, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry boundaries."

questions.question: Should DynamoDB stream relay run in cmd/riido_ai_server or as a separate worker process?
questions.stance: Adapter core is public; runtime topology is infra/deployment-owned until decided.

questions.stance: Public repo stores only safe seed shape and token-hash provisioning; operations lifecycle is private evidence.

questions.question: Should a desktop-managed daemon stop on app quit for every environment profile, or should staging/development/production daemon instances have profile-scoped lifecycle ownership that can stay online independently?
questions.stance: Current evidence shows desktop app quit can gracefully stop the desktop-managed daemon, leaving SaaS runtime settings to show the device offline. Public control-plane should expose daemon state and stop-source evidence but must not infer local launcher intent. The ownership rule belongs in the desktop/daemon lifecycle contract.
questions.next_artifact: desktop daemon lifecycle/profile ownership manifest with stop-source evidence
questions.next_command: gh issue create --repo teamswyg/riido-desktop --title "Q-CP-008 desktop daemon profile lifecycle ownership" --body "Produce desktop daemon lifecycle/profile ownership manifest with stop-source evidence."

questions.question: Should the Windows app waitlist, launch-notification, and marketing-consent action from Figma node-id=275-22731 and web onboarding node-id=236-29749 be implemented in the AI Agent control-plane client API or delegated to an existing product/user-marketing API?
questions.stance: Resolved as no-diff for the AI Agent control-plane client API. The generated client exposes only GET /v1/client/ai-agent/devices for runtime empty-state composition.
questions.resolution: Windows waitlist, launch notification, and marketing-consent actions remain client/product facts unless a future product/marketing SSOT defines a separate generated surface. This server must not expose AI Agent waitlist or marketing-consent endpoints.

loop.observation: The open questions page was a hand-maintained table, so unresolved decisions had no machine-checkable owner, next artifact, or executable next command.
loop.hypothesis: A decision queue manifest can generate the reader and verify that every open question has an owner, next executable artifact, and bounded next command.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the open questions manifest, publish open command evidence, and run the openquestions verifier in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on duplicate ids, unknown statuses, missing owners, missing next artifacts, missing or unsafe next commands for open questions, or stale generated docs.
loop.retrospective: This keeps planning uncertainty visible without treating prose as the source of truth.
